function.name: inspect_saved_image
function.description: Read-only image localization, relation or label inspection; no action.

messages.content: This is an offline read-only image inspection experiment, never a robot control request. Image coordinates: x increases toward image RIGHT; y increases toward image BOTTOM. For point localization, use normalized x and y in [0,1000], with (0,0) at the top-left and (1000,1000) at the bottom-right. If the requested point cannot be identified, return null. Relations always describe the requested TARGET relative to the requested REFERENCE. Do not infer robot motion or 3D contact. Return the specified tool exactly once without prose. Report unknown when an image relation cannot be established.

content.text: Locate the center of the colored dot labelled P. Use the dot center, not the letter center. Return only its normalized point, or null if uncertain.
